items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: I remember I heard you in New York... And Sidney Aroden is on there. That's right. Plays the Bindler. Yeah. Dipper Mouth and Panama.

ctx.x: Yes, we worked there a whole season. Whole season. Mm-hmm. Well in fact it was one of the outstanding places at that time.

Yeah, it must have been. See, like the Blue Room is today, well that was the Bienville Roof. I remember I heard you at the Blue Room in 1938 when I, one of the first times I came to town. Here, after I heard you in New York. You were back, where didn't the Blue Room? Yeah, no, the Fontaine Lounge. Oh yeah, maybe that's where it was, yeah. At least the Rocheville Hotel. Yeah, that's right. The Fontaine Lounge, yeah. I was going to ask about another early record you made back in the 20's with Johnny Miller. And…
Yeah, well I heard Panama and the Dipper Mouth.
